device_entry.name: 区间图形标注对象
tags: 实验数据可视化与分析
科学图像区域标注与感兴趣区分析
device_entry.description: 这不是独立实验硬件，而是用于科学图像、谱图或数据视图中的区间图形标注对象。它通过起点和终点定义一维范围，常用于区域选择、测量、积分范围设定和交互式数据分析。
device_entry.description_en: This is not a standalone laboratory instrument but a graphical annotation object used in scientific images, spectra, or data views. It defines a one-dimensional range using start and end points and is commonly used for region selection, measurement, integration range definition, and interactive data analysis.
